newsitem.title: USA: Harveys Casino to sell stake in hotel/casino.
newsitem.headline: Harveys Casino to sell stake in hotel/casino.

text.p: Hard Rock Hotel Inc said on Tuesday it will purchase Harveys Casino Resorts' interest in the Hard Rock Hotel and Casino for $45 million in cash.
Harveys will continue to manage the property between now and the closing of the transaction, and no personnel changes are anticipated, the privately held Hard Rock Hotel Inc said.
The deal, which is expected to take four to six months to complete, is subject to certain conditions and approvals, including approval by Nevada gaming authorities, Hard Rock said.
Upon completion, the Hard Rock will be self-managed, it added.
